metadata.description: The catalogue of the BASE MAPS an EM client may draw under its places: XYZ tile sources, each with its licence and whether its terms let a copy be kept OFFLINE. One catalogue for EMStudio (frontend/src/geoglobe.ts SOURCES, where it was born, 23 Oct 2026) and StratiField (the map of a room). Not datamodel: no node, no edge, nothing exported. NIGHT impronte di saggi e tagli (12 Nov 2026): moved here from EMStudio's literal, VERBATIM (the four entries of geoglobe.ts SOURCES at EMStudio main, 12 Nov 2026), so the two clients read one list.

consumers.stratigraph-chatbot: sync-basi.sh copies this file into app/basi.json; the node's tile bridge (GET /v1/tiles/{source}/{z}/{x}/{y}) serves only what is listed here, caches on disk, never prefetches a source with offline:false.
consumers.EMStudio: NOT YET: geoglobe.ts still holds its literal. To read it from here: add `cp "$CFG/em_basemap_sources.json" "$DST/"` to frontend/scripts/sync-datamodels.sh and `import BASEMAPS from './assets/em_basemap_sources.json'; export const SOURCES: GeoSource[] = BASEMAPS.sources as GeoSource[];` in geoglobe.ts (the fields are the GeoSource interface's, one for one).

metadata.fields: id, kind (imagery|terrain), label, url (XYZ template, {z}/{x}/{y}), minZoom, maxZoom, tileSize, format, attribution, licence, licenceUrl, offline (may a copy be kept: the SOURCE's terms, not ours), offlineNote, encoding (terrarium), planet (a PMTiles of the planet)
